description:
Pensieve gives your AI a shared, cited understanding of your company. Read the company map, follow claims to their sources, and contribute knowledge through Pensieve.

The plugin combines the Pensieve MCP connection with three role skills: Chief of Staff for operating briefs, Head of Product for customer evidence and priorities, and Head of Growth for judging channels and experiments.

Install the plugin and sign in to your Pensieve account. You do not need to install a separate connector. Access follows your Pensieve context memberships.

This directory installation provides MCP access and the three skills. Automatic context loading and conversation capture require a separate local plugin setup in a supported client.

Setup and supported client features: https://docs.pensieve.uk/mcp-server/clients
Source: https://github.com/pensieve-io/plugins

defaultPrompt: Brief me on what changed across the company.
What should our product team focus on next?
Which growth channels are delivering results?
